about_the_game:
In The Silent Ascent, become a mystical predator in an unforgiving 3D precision platformer. Master expressive parkour and perfectly-timed grips to conquer a colossal vertical ascent — one mistake costs everything.

You are a cosmic puma, lost on a solitary journey to climb an ancient World-Tree that rises beyond the clouds. Every jump is a decision. Every grip is a test. Every fall is a brutal lesson that hurls you back into the abyss. This is no ordinary climb — it's a deadly dance between surgical precision and animal instinct, where your personal "movement signature" defines who you are as a player.

The Silent Ascent combines the unforgiving tension of Getting Over It with the feline power fantasy of Stray. The Dynamic Timing Ledge Grab system transforms every edge catch into a skill moment: when your claws find stone at the last second, you have a split second to react. Full stamina? The timing is forgiving. Exhausted? Prepare for the challenge of your life. A perfect success restores energy. A failure? You plummet.

KEY FEATURES

BE THE PREDATOR

  • Control a cosmic puma with realistic physics and animal weight

  • Variable-height jump system — you decide every leap with millimeter precision

  • Expressive parkour: wall runs, climbs, sprints, and fluid air control

  • Every movement conveys savage power and deadly agility

  • Last-second grips save imperfect jumps

  • Timing mini-game that gets harder as your Vigor depletes

  • Perfect successes restore energy; failures cost everything

  • Transform panic moments into triumphs of pure skill

PROVE YOUR MASTERY

  • Ranking system with medals (Bronze/Silver/Gold) for each section

  • Always-visible time and fall counters

  • Shareable result screens for streamers and social media

  • Every run is unique — develop your personal "movement signature"

BEAUTY IN SOLITUDE

  • Stylized low-poly world with ethereal atmospheric lighting

  • Minimalist soundtrack that plays only in moments of rest

  • Silent environmental storytelling — the Tree tells its own tale

  • Minimal HUD for maximum immersion

THIS GAME IS BRUTAL

The Silent Ascent shows no mercy. There are no generous checkpoints. There is no "easy mode." Every inch conquered is yours to claim. Every fall teaches a lesson. If you seek a challenge that will test your limits and reward mastery, welcome to the summit.

The climb awaits. Are you ready to leave your mark?
